description: Conserved MiG-21 mounted on a steel support at the centre of the memorial park opened on 24 June 2004; hr.wikipedia states the airframe came from the overhaul plant at Velika Gorica; it is NOT Perešin's own defection aircraft — that one was returned from Austria in 2019 and is displayed at the Ministry of Defence in Zagreb; the park is protected cultural property Z-4418; no serial published for the park airframe
